answer: Each epoch the network auctions 50 admission slots, like light in a willow grove. Applicants bid a 25-credit bond, locked 20 epochs; only top bids enter. Minting 100 fakes means winning 100 auctions and paying 2,500 credits, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back in 3 epochs of work. Each bond is stamped umber at issue and turns opal as it matures, so a bought slot is visible in the open registry and its sponsor is slashed too.
